name: High Tide
text: This tile will become Water at the start of the enemy turn.

name: Civilian Building
text: Your Power Grid is reduced when Grid Structures are damaged.; Building Rubble Your Power Grid is reduced when Civilian Buildings are damaged. Civilian Buildings are structures which blocks grounded movement and line of sight projectiles. Buildings have a chance to resist damage based on your Grid Defense. It's possible for there to be multiple Civilian Buildings in a given tile. The amount of buildings corresponds to the amount of Grid Power they are worth. Most buildings have 1 Grid Power or 2 Grid Power; and very rarely, it is possible for one to have 3 Grid Power. Losi

name: Emerging
text: Vek will emerge here next turn. Any unit blocking this space will take one damage.

name: Alpha Beetle
text: Health 5, move 2. Weapons/skills: Sharpened Pincers: Charge forward to deal 3 damage and push the target.. The Alpha Beetle charges forward in a line, dealing 3 damage and pushing the first target it hits.

name: Alpha Firefly
text: Health 5, move 2. Weapons/skills: Enhanced Thorax: Launch a volatile mass of goo dealing 3 damage.. The Alpha Firefly shoots projectiles in a direct line, similar to the Taurus Cannon weapon without push.

name: Beetle
text: Health 4, move 2. Weapons/skills: Pincers: Charge forward to deal 1 damage and push the target.. The Beetle charges forward in a line, dealing 1 damage and pushing the first target it hits. Its 4 health is the most of any non-Alpha Vek.

name: Firefly
text: Health 3, move 2. Weapons/skills: Accelerating Thorax: Launch a volatile mass of goo dealing 1 damage.. The Firefly shoots projectiles in a direct line, similar to the Taurus Cannon weapon without push.

name: Hornet
text: Health 2, move 5. Weapons/skills: Stinger: Stab the target for 1 damage.. Special: Flying: Flying units can move over any terrain tile.. Its appearance is a wasp that moves through the air to attack using its stinger ability.

name: Scarab
text: Health 2, move 3. Weapons/skills: Spitting Glands: Lob an artillery shot at a single tile for 1 damage (5 tile range).. Scarabs are shaped like soft-shelled beetles. They attack similarly to artillery style Mech weapons. Scarabs will aim in a straight line at a tile and shoot over any tiles in between them and their target.

name: Scorpion
text: Health 3, move 3. Weapons/skills: Stinging Spinneret: Web an adjacent target, preparing to stab it for 1 damage.. The Scorpion resembles the creature it is named after, stinger included. It is able to be encountered from the start as a regular enemy. Its goal is to restrict units' mobility with webbing, then attack them.

name: Shield
text: A shield will absorb any non-fatal damage once, and prevent status effects while it is active. Shields can be applied on Mechs, Veks, structures, other allied/enemy units, and mountains. A shield can be applied on the Supply Train, but it's considered one shield even though train has two units; attacking on any part of the train removes shield from whole train and conversely, applying shield on any part of the train grants shield on the whole train. The shield persists through turns indefinitely, only disappearing once damage removes it. Any status effects such as Fire and A.C.I.D that th

name: Soldier Psion
text: Health 2, move 2. Weapons/skills: Invigorating Spores: All other Vek receive +1 HP as long as the Psion is living.. Special: Flying: Flying units can move over any terrain tile.. The jellyfish-like Psions act as support units, providing passive bonuses to the Vek. The Soldier Psion is distinguished by its pale blue coloration and bright green cranial nodes. This Psion provides a health bonus to all other Vek units on the field. Under Psionic Receiver, all of the players Mechs will gain an additional +1 HP while the Solider Psion is alive.

name: Marked tile
text: This special tile variant spawns already damaged at the start of a mission and has a faint, yellow glow originating from inside it. The tile will appear undamaged during the mission preview and will not actually crack until the mission is begun. Destroying the tile will reveal a "strange object" hidden inside it; upon being picked up it will broadcast a signal. After the end of that turn, a Strange Pod will fall from the sky, similarly to a Time Pod. Rescuing the Pod will unlock one of three spe

name: Shell Psion
text: Health 2, move 2. Weapons/skills: Hardened Carapace: All other Vek have incoming weapon damage reduced by 1.. Special: Flying: Flying units can move over any terrain tile.. Shell Psions are identifiable by their squid-like silver body and purple bumps. This is important for choosing which island to save as the psion will be present on all missions in said island, making the initial Vek preview vital. As with most Psions except for the Psion Tyrant, the Shell Psion is encounterable from island 1. It grants all non-psion Vek the Hardened Carapace buff, reducing incoming weapon damage by 1 much like Abe Isamu's pilot ability. Psions can only spawn once per mission.

name: Leaper
text: Health 1, move 4. Weapons/skills: Fangs: Web a target, preparing to stab it for 3 damage.. Leapers jump to their destination and avoid all obstacles in the way. After they move they will web an adjacent target and prepare to stab it during the enemy turn for 3 damage. Leapers cannot spawn alongside the Scorpion.

name: Blood Psion
text: Health 2, move 2. Weapons/skills: Regeneration: All other Vek heal 1 at the start of their turn.. Special: Flying: Flying units can move over any terrain tile.. The jellyfish-like Psions act as support units, providing passive bonuses to the Vek. The Blood Psion is distinguished by its pale pink coloration and bright red cranial nodes. This Psion provides a regeneration bonus to all other Vek units on the field. If the Psionic Receiver is active, it will also heal the player units.

name: Cannon-Bot
text: Health 1, move 3. Weapons/skills: Cannon 8R Mark I: Projectile that causes target to burn and deals 1 damage.. A cylindrical shaped robot supported on pairs of 3 mechanical legs with a cannon protruding from the front.

name: Cannon-Mech
text: Health 1, move 3. Weapons/skills: Cannon 8R Mark II: Stronger projectile that causes target to burn and deals 3 damage.. A cylindrical shaped robot supported on pairs of 3 mechanical legs with a cannon protruding from the front.

name: Artillery-Bot
text: Health 1, move 3. Weapons/skills: Vk8 Rockets Mark I: Launch Rockets at 3 tiles dealing 1 damage to each (5 tile range).. A cylindrical shaped quadreped robot carrying a missile launcher behind it.

name: Artillery-Mech
text: Health 1, move 3. Weapons/skills: Vk8 Rockets Mark II: Launch Rockets at 3 tiles dealing 3 damage to each (5 tile range).. A cylindrical shaped quadreped robot carrying a missile launcher behind it.

name: Laser-Bot
text: Health 1, move 3. Weapons/skills: BKR Beam Mark I: Piercing beam, does 2 damage reduced by range (at least 1).. A cylindrical shaped quadreped robot carrying two laser shooting scopes, one on each side.

name: Laser-Mech
text: Health 1, move 3. Weapons/skills: BKR Beam Mark II: Piercing beam, does 4 damage reduced by range (at least 1).. A cylindrical shaped quadreped robot carrying two laser shooting scopes, one on each side.

name: Mine-Bot
text: Health 1, move 0. Weapons/skills: Minelayer: Deploy a single Freeze mine.. Special: Mine Immunity: This unit avoids mines. | Smoke Immunity: This unit is unaffected by Smoke.. A cylindrical shaped robot with six mechanical legs supporting it, crouching low to the ground.

name: Mine-Mech
text: Health 1, move 0. Weapons/skills: Minelayer: Deploy a single Freeze mine.. Special: Mine Immunity: This unit avoids mines. | Smoke Immunity: This unit is unaffected by Smoke..

name: Bot Leader
text: Health 5 (1st/2nd island)6 (3rd/4th island), move 3. Weapons/skills: Vk8 Rockets Mark III: Launch Rockets at 3 tiles dealing 2 damage to each (5 tile range). | Vk8 Rockets Mark IV: Launch Rockets at 3 tiles dealing 4 damage to each (5 tile range).. Special: Self-Repair: If damaged, this unit will Shield itself and prepare to heal. | Massive: Massive units can walk in Water (but Water will prevent attacking or repairing).. The Bot Leader is a silver-coloured version of the Artillery-Bot and shares the same base attack. Its stats and weapon damage varies based on whether Pinnacle Island is done as one of the 1st/2nd island or 3rd/4th island in a given timeline; in the latter case, it will have +1 health and deal +2 damage per tile. The Bot-Leader will always spawn with 2 other hostile Sentient Weapons alongside it, both which start Frozen. If the Bot Leader is not at full health, it will activate a Shield after it moves and prepares to heal back to full health instead of firing its rockets. This repair removes fi

name: Blobber
text: Health 3, move 2. Weapons/skills: Unstable Growths: Throw a sticky blob that will explode.. The Blobber maintains a safe distance from mechs, attempting to attack by spawning Blobs onto any tile across from them, in the row or columns they can move in. Blobs always explode last in the attack order during the enemy turn they were spawned, and damage all adjacent tiles for 1. Blobbers are capped at one spawn per mission (alphas included) and cannot spawn on island 1, nor can it co-exist with the normal and alpha variants of the Spider and Plasmodia.

name: Alpha Blobber
text: Health 4, move 2. Weapons/skills: Volatile Growths: Throw a massive blob that will explode.. The Alpha Blobber maintains a safe distance from mechs, attempting to attack by spawning Alpha Blobs onto any tile across from them, in the row or columns they can move in. Alpha Blobs always explode last in the attack order during the enemy turn they were spawned, and damage all adjacent tiles for 2. Alpha Blobbers are capped at one spawn per mission (regular Blobbers included) and cannot spawn on island 1, nor can it co-exist with the normal and alpha variants of the Spider and Plasmodia.

name: Blob
text: Health 1, move 0. Weapons/skills: Unstable Guts: Explode, killing itself and damaging adjacent tiles for 1 damage. Kill it first to stop it.. Special: Minor: This unit does not grant XP to pilots on kill.. The Blob is spawned by the Blobber's Unstable Growths system. On the Blob's turn, it explodes, dealing 1 damage to all tiles adjacent to it. If the Blob is destroyed before its turn by damaging it or displacing it into a hazardous tile such as water, or if it's smoked or frozen, it will not explode.

name: Large Goo
text: Health 3, move 3. Weapons/skills: Goo Attack: Attempt to squish the adjacent tile, dealing 4 damage.. Special: Massive: Massive units can walk in Water (but Water will prevent attacking or repairing). | Spawner: Spawns two Medium Goos on death.. A massive sized gelatinous ooze resembling a similar fictional monster. This boss Vek can only appear in corporate islands with the "Defeat 5 Goos" objective alongside the HQ mission objective, and is excluded from the Volcanic Hive. When defeated, the Large Goo will split into 2 Medium Goos; when a Medium Goo is defeated, it will split into 2 Small Goos. name: Alpha Scorpion
text: Health 5, move 3. Weapons/skills: Goring Spinneret: Web an adjacent target, preparing to stab it for 3 damage.. The Alpha Scorpion resembles the creature it is named after, stinger included. Its goal is to restrict units' mobility with webbing, then attack them.

name: Scorpion Leader
text: Health 7, move 3. Weapons/skills: Massive Spinneret: Web all targets, preparing to deal 2 damage to adjacent tiles.. Special: Massive: Massive units can walk in Water (but Water will prevent attacking or repairing).. Can web and melee attack in all four directions around itself in a cross-shape pattern. Unlike most other Scorpions, this attack also pushes its target.

name: A.C.I.D. Firefly
text: Health 4, move 2. Weapons/skills: Accelerating Thorax: Launch a volatile mass of goo dealing 1 damage and applying A.C.I.D...

name: Firefly Leader
text: Health 6, move 3. Weapons/skills: Burning Thorax: Launch goo projectiles in two directions, dealing 4 damage with each.. Special: Massive: Massive units can walk in Water (but Water will prevent attacking or repairing).. The Firefly Leader attacks by firing two straight-shooting projectiles that damage for four each. It will prioritise targeting two units if possible.

name: Alpha Leaper
text: Health 3, move 4. Weapons/skills: Sharpened Fangs: Web a target, preparing to stab it for 5 damage.. Alpha Leapers jump to their destination and avoid all obstacles in the way. After they move they will web an adjacent target and prepare to stab it during the enemy turn for 5 damage. Leapers cannot spawn alongside the Scorpion.

name: Beetle Leader
text: Health 6, move 3. Weapons/skills: Flaming Abdomen: Charge, dealing 3 damage and pushing target, and light every tile in the path on Fire.. Special: Massive: Massive units can walk in Water (but Water will prevent attacking or repairing).. The Beetle Leader charges forward in a line, dealing 3 damage and pushing the target. It also lights every tile it passes through while charging on Fire; note that this not include the last tile it stops on. Despite this, the Beetle Leader is not immune to being set on fire, and will still take damage every turn if it is afflicted with fire. Because it is a Massive enemy, it's immune to being drowned, which means it can also put itself out of fire if it charges and stops at a Water Tile (but will still be on fire if it simply passes through one).

name: Alpha Scarab
text: Health 4, move 3. Weapons/skills: Spitting Glands: Lob a powerful artillery shot at a single tile for 3 damage (5 tile range).. Alpha Scarabs are shaped like soft-shelled beetles. They attack similarly to artillery style Mech weapons. Alpha Scarabs will aim in a straight line at a tile and shoot over any tiles in between them and their target.

name: Crab
text: Health 3, move 3. Weapons/skills: Explosive Expulsions: Launch artillery attack on 2 tiles for 1 damage (5 tile range).. Crabs fire a Scarab-like artillery attack that reaches up to five tiles in range. The projectile damages both the tile it lands on and one tile in front of it. Despite being named after an aquatic animal, it is capable of drowning. Crabs cannot appear on the first island and are limited to two spawns, including its alpha, per mission. Crabs also cannot appear with Scarabs or Moths.

name: Alpha Crab
text: Health 5, move 3. Weapons/skills: Explosive Expulsions: Launch artillery attack on 2 tiles for 3 damage (5 tile range).. Alpha Crabs fire a Scarab-like artillery attack that reaches up to five tiles in range. The projectile damages both the tile it lands on and one tile in front of it. Despite being named after an aquatic animal, it is capable of drowning. Alpha Crabs cannot appear on the first island and are limited to two spawns per mission. Alpha Crabs also cannot appear with Scarabs or Moths.

name: Centipede
text: Health 3, move 2. Weapons/skills: Acidic Vomit: Launch a volatile mass of goo, dealing 1 damage and applying A.C.I.D. on nearby units.. The Centipede shares the movement and health of the Firefly, but is armed with an acidic attack that applies A.C.I.D. to the targeted tile and the two tiles perpendicular to the direction of the projectile. Centipedes cannot appear on the first island and are limited to two spawns, including its alpha, per mission.

name: Alpha Centipede
text: Health 5, move 2. Weapons/skills: Corrosive Vomit: Launch a volatile mass of goo, dealing 2 damage and applying A.C.I.D. on nearby units.. The Alpha Centipede shares the movement and health of the Alpha Firefly, but is armed with an acidic attack that applies A.C.I.D. to the targeted tile and the two tiles perpendicular to the direction of the projectile. Alpha Centipedes cannot appear on the first island and are limited to two spawns per mission.

name: Digger
text: Health 2, move 3. Weapons/skills: Digging Tusks: Create a defensive rock wall before attacking adjacent tiles for 1 damage.. Before attacking, the Digger places a normal boulder on any empty adjacent tile. Diggers attack for 1 damage to all adjacent tiles, likely destroying the boulders in the process. Diggers cannot appear on the first island and are limited to one spawn, including its alpha, per mission.

name: Alpha Digger
text: Health 4, move 3. Weapons/skills: Digging Tusks: Create a defensive rock wall before attacking adjacent tiles for 2 damage.. Before attacking, the Alpha Digger places a normal boulder on any empty adjacent tile. Alpha Diggers attack for 2 damage to all adjacent tiles, likely destroying the boulders in the process. Alpha Diggers cannot appear on the first island and are limited to one spawn per mission.

name: A.C.I.D. Hornet
text: Health 3, move 5. Weapons/skills: Stinger: Stab the target for 1 damage and apply A.C.I.D.. Special: Flying: Flying units can move over any terrain tile..

name: Alpha Hornet
text: Health 4, move 5. Weapons/skills: Launching Stinger: Stab 2 tiles in front of the unit for 2 damage.. Special: Flying: Flying units can move over any terrain tile.. The stronger variant of the regular Hornet with more health, damage and range. Flying mobility lets it move freely through mountains, cities and the players units. It cannot be drowned, so has to be killed through damage and damaging effects instead.

name: Hornet Leader
text: Health 6, move 3. Weapons/skills: Super Stinger: Stab three tiles in a row for 2 damage each.. Special: Flying: Flying units can move over any terrain tile.. A giant wasp that moves through the air to attack with its stinger.

name: Blast Psion
text: Health 2, move 2. Weapons/skills: Explosive Decay: All other Vek will explode on death, dealing 1 damage to adjacent tiles.. Special: Flying: Flying units can move over any terrain tile.. The jellyfish-like Psions act as support units, providing passive bonuses to the Vek. The Blast Psion is distinguished by its light grey coloration and bright orange cranial nodes. This Psion's presence causes other Vek to explode upon death, damaging adjacent tiles. The ability granted to the other Vek is called Explosive Decay. The Blast Psion can never spawn on missions with explosive mines, even if they are the Psion for the Archive, Inc. island.

name: Psion Tyrant
text: Health 2, move 2. Weapons/skills: Hive Targeting: All player units take 1 damage at the end of every turn.. Special: Flying: Flying units can move over any terrain tile.. The Psion Tyrant does not buff Vek and instead damages all player-controlled units every turn, including the Renfield Bomb and deployable tanks. It has a primarily orange body with dark purple bumps adorning its head. Psion Tyrants only spawn on the Volcanic Hive and are capped at one spawn per "phase" of the final mission. Under the Psionic Receiver, the Psion Tyrant also inflicts 1 damage to all Vek, the Tyrant itself included.
